triage.title: A filter that learns from my decisions
triage.body: Four layers sort a daily stream: fixed filters, a logistic regression with no ML library, Claude scoring, and weekly rule proposals I accept or reject. The day I switched the model on, it discarded 46 items in minutes. I restored all 46 from the audit trail. I added a threshold cap and a daily circuit breaker, and wrote the post-mortem.

playbook.title: Deciding what not to build
playbook.body: Borrowed from four books: one page naming the riskiest assumption, a 5-day prototype, two paid channels, kill criteria written before I spend, a verdict at week 4.
playbook.milhas: <head>MilhasGrupo.</head> Alerts for families when 3 to 6 award seats open on the same flight to Orlando. Ads were live in about 3 days, and I ran the service by hand.
playbook.fire: <head>FIRE-BR.</head> A one-page hypothesis for a Brazilian financial-independence planner.
playbook.quote: If you can’t articulate the riskiest assumption in one sentence, the idea isn’t ready.
